patterns.note: Full-width content sections with generous vertical spacing, often featuring centered or left-aligned text blocks and media.
Prominent, large, and bold sans-serif headings are contrasted with smaller, lighter-weight body text for clear hierarchy.
A high-contrast monochrome palette of dark grey/black text on white/light grey backgrounds, with vibrant blue and green used sparingly for calls to action and highlights.
A sticky navigation bar remains fixed at the top of the viewport, while content sections below the hero scroll vertically, and specific content blocks utilize horizontal carousels for browsing.
A distinctive large-scale graphic section ('Three years of the real human network' with '€(3)') acts as a visual anchor, breaking the flow of standard content blocks.

technique_notes: A fixed header navigation bar remains visible at the top of the viewport throughout the scroll, providing persistent access to site navigation.
A full-bleed hero video plays automatically and scrolls out of view as the user scrolls down the page, serving as an immersive initial visual experience.

Interactive horizontal carousels (using a library like Swiper) are employed for displaying collections of content such as 'World Updates' and 'World Stories', allowing users to swipe or click through items within a confined vertical space.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body text) create strong visual impact, while body text is legible and well-spaced.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding on buttons and interactive elements, with sharp corners for most content blocks and images.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced density with generous vertical spacing between major sections, creating an airy feel, while internal content blocks maintain a more compact rhythm.

standout: This site stands out with its bold, almost stark, black and white aesthetic, punctuated by a full-bleed video hero and a unique, large-scale graphic ('€(3)') that visually reinforces its core message. The integration of horizontal content carousels adds a modern, interactive dimension to content browsing.
